description: Read-only user-maintained Android package list for Linux Mode reports. Android package and memory policy is never changed by this project.
notes: This file is informational and is used to label packages the user wants to keep visible in reports.
Linux Mode does not change Android settings, AppOps, package state, process state, LMKD, zRAM, kernel parameters, or system services.
Unknown packages are left untouched. Add only exact package names that the user wants documented as important.
